features.statement: Page declares a document language attribute on the html element.
Content is wrapped in a main landmark element.
Page uses ARIA attributes for accessibility.
Logo and images carry descriptive alt text rather than empty or missing alt.
Deeper heading hierarchy with an h2 section heading and h4 card titles.
Lean DOM with few divs and few unique CSS classes.
Page title is short and brand-only, without keyword lists.
Layout built with flexbox and grid rather than legacy techniques.
Content sits in a consistent centered max-width container across sections.
Card grids use four equal columns, with cards stretched to equal row height.
Typography uses the system-ui font stack instead of a webfont.
Large bold headings (48px h1, 32px h2) with roomy body line height around 1.55.
Body text is dark slate on a light gray-blue page background.
Palette is dark navy with a single vivid orange accent.
Sections alternate flat light and dark navy bands, with a navy footer.
Primary buttons are solid orange with slightly rounded corners.
Pill-shaped filter buttons let users filter card lists by category.
Content cards are white, rounded, bordered or shadowed, with bold navy titles.
Status badges are uppercase rounded pills overlaid on card images.
Header has a dark utility strip above a white bar with logo and inline nav.
Hero is a full-bleed image with overlaid headline, subtitle and call-to-action button.
Centered section headings with a short orange accent underline.
Newsletter signup uses a labeled accent button with an 'Email address' placeholder.
Social links are rendered as text-labeled pills rather than icon glyphs.
Secondary links are consolidated into a footer column rather than mid-page.
Card images reuse one placeholder photo across all cards.
Added marketing microcopy: hero subtitle, helper prompts and 'View location →' arrow links.
